description: Record a new task for yourself as a result of self-review. Available ONLY in the SELF_REVIEW phase. After adding all tasks call transitionTo into the working phase — the frame will execute them there.
name: addTask

description.description: What exactly needs to be done

description: Mark the task as done. Use this tool after you have performed all the actions described in the task or fixed the problem found by the setter.
name: completeTask

reason.description: Optional: closing reason/comment. Required for "decision items" of the checklist (for example, refusing a book promotion): such an item is closed by a SEPARATE call with an explicit reason, not silently in a common batch.

description: Mark several tasks as done in one call. Use for going through the working phase's checklist in a row (for example, closing several 'chk-*' items) when there are no intermediate decisions between them. If an idea appears along the way — close them one by one via completeTask. REVIEW items ('rev-*', the self-check phase) are NOT closed by this tool: each requires a separate completeTask with a verdict-specific in reason, batch closing is rejected.
name: completeTasks

ids.description: List of task IDs to close

description:
Confirm INTENTIONAL isolation of a part of the map (a secret room, etc.).
        |Allowed ONLY if the legend has a hidden-passage symbol with an opening mechanic.
        |Without this confirmation a disconnected map will not pass the final check.
name: confirmIsolation

justification.description: Rationale: which zone is isolated and how it is entered (the passage symbol).

closesTaskId.description: Optional. ID of the task or issue that is FULLY resolved by THIS call — pass it OPTIMISTICALLY when you are confident in the arguments. If the call returns an error, the wrapper itself will NOT close the task. Don't use it for partial progress; for multi-tool tasks, close via completeTask after the final step.

description:
Set the map's ASCII grid and the terrain description for the artist.
        |One symbol = one cell, rows of strictly equal length. Alphabet: `a-z`, `A-Z`
        |(case matters), `0-9`, `+-*=/\|:;,`. Conventions: `#` wall, `.` floor, `~` water,
        |space — "no cell". A repeat call overwrites the grid entirely.
name: setGrid

grid.description: ASCII grid. One row = one row of cells.

terrain.description: Terrain description for the image render: style, materials, lighting. WITHOUT mentioning grid symbols.

closesTaskId.description: Optional. ID of the task or issue that is FULLY resolved by THIS call — pass it OPTIMISTICALLY when you are confident in the arguments. If the call returns an error, the wrapper itself will NOT close the task. Don't use it for partial progress; for multi-tool tasks, close via completeTask after the final step.

description:
Set the map legend IN FULL (a repeat call overwrites).
        |Each entry has: `symbol` (one symbol from the grid), `description` (for the MASTER: mechanics,
        |DC, tactical properties — the player does not see it), `name` (OPTIONAL: a short artistic
        |caption for the PLAYER over the map — only for key buildings/objects; do not give a name to the hidden and
        |base terrain).
name: setLegend

symbol.description: Map symbol — EXACTLY ONE character (a letter a-z/A-Z, a digit 0-9 or one of +-*=/|:;,). Case matters: 'H' and 'h' are different symbols.

description.description: Description for the master: tactical/mechanical properties (cover, line-of-sight blocking, effects, DC). Not shown to the players.

name.description: Optional, STINGY (0-4 per map) — a short artistic caption for the PLAYER over the map (the client will gather the symbol's cells into a cluster and draw the caption in the center): 'Hut', 'Altar', 'Well'. WITHOUT name: base terrain ('.', '#', '~', stones), decorative props and the HIDDEN (a trap/cache with a caption = a spoiler to the player).

closesTaskId.description: Optional. ID of the task or issue that is FULLY resolved by THIS call — pass it OPTIMISTICALLY when you are confident in the arguments. If the call returns an error, the wrapper itself will NOT close the task. Don't use it for partial progress; for multi-tool tasks, close via completeTask after the final step.

description: Transition to another state (phase) of work. Call it once the current phase's work is complete — as the LAST call of the SAME response that finishes that work (when the phase rules allow the transition). The switch is applied at the END of this response: every other call in the same response still runs in the CURRENT phase, so it is safe to finish the phase's work and request the transition together. Do not spend a separate response on a lone transition call, and do not place new work AFTER the transition expecting the new phase.
name: transitionTo

description: Give a verdict on EVERY item of the self-check checklist from the phase description: the item id, ok=true if satisfied, otherwise ok=false and what is wrong in problem. Call AFTER the last completeTask, last in the response — without a valid selfCheck the work will not complete.
name: selfCheck

problem.description: when ok=false: what exactly is violated
